crossRefs.note: In Jerusalem, he made devices, invented by skillful men, to be on the towers and on the battlements, with which to…

translations.web: He will set his battering engines against your walls, and with his axes he will break down your towers.
translations.bsb: He will direct the blows of his battering rams against your walls and tear down your towers with his axes.
translations.kjv: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.
translations.asv: And he shall set his battering engines against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.
